Selector: no project test-impact tool found (nwdes runs none); mechanical selection by touched-file class names: RestoreAndClearWhileTheDatabaseIsOpenTest, SqliteDatabaseManagementProviderTest, SecretReadPathSourceStructureTest (slice Verification) plus consumer DatabaseManagementServiceTest. argv: dotnet test Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~Acceptance.DatabaseManagement.RestoreAndClearWhileTheDatabaseIsOpenTest|FullyQualifiedName~SqliteDatabaseManagementProviderTest|FullyQualifiedName~SecretReadPathSourceStructureTest|FullyQualifiedName~DatabaseManagementServiceTest' exit 0; stdout 'Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 67, Skipped: 0, Total: 67'; stderr empty. RED was host-observed (not repeated). Jev unauthorized; typesafe: unavailable.

Adversarial read of SqliteDatabaseManagementProvider.cs: restore and clear copy pages via BackupDatabase in one transaction into the live db, so a failed restore leaves the live data unchanged; no live file replaced or deleted; sources and live connections are Pooling=False and disposed by using; Postgres untouched; consumer DatabaseManagementService still migrates and seeds after. No data-loss, mixed-data or handle-leak defect found. Uncertainty not exercised by any test: SQLite refuses a backup into a WAL-mode destination whose page size differs from the source; both are the 4096 default in practice, so reported as an unverified edge, not a defect.

diagnostic: Accepted: restore/clear via online backup API is atomic, leaves no stale or mixed data, leaks no handles; 67/67 selected tests green on a16c35880; two non-blocking advisories (duplicate 10000 literal, dropped absent-file Clear row).
